## Core Signature Specializations
1. **Sacred Devbhoomi & Mahadev Tattoos**: Custom Mahadev Trishul, Damru, Third Eye, Om Namah Shivaya Sanskrit Calligraphy, Sacred Geometry Mandalas.
2. **Fine-Line Single Needle Realism**: Minimalist florals, geometric scripts, micro-portraits, and precise linework with zero blowout.
3. **Hyper-Realistic Portraiture & Animal Realism**: Lion monarchs, wolves, mythological deities, and realistic tribute portraits.
4. **Custom Cover-Ups & Reworks**: Expert geometric and darkwork cover-ups over old or faded tattoos.
5. **Interactive 3D Placement Studio**: Proprietary web tool allowing clients to preview tattoo designs on a 360-degree anatomical mannequin (https://www.landofgod.in/interactive-3d).

## Hygiene & Safety Standards
- 100% single-use medical grade EO gas-sterilized needle cartridges (Cheyenne, Kwadron).
- Medical-grade autoclave sterilization, certified vegan organic inks (Dynamic, Eternal, Intenze).
- Hospital-grade cross-contamination barriers and sterile disposable grips.
- Personalized medical aftercare guidance provided for every client.
